result.brief: 提出以表征为中心的世界动作模型，通过未来预测、SIGReg 分布稳定与冻结几何先验构建世界表征，并用视觉-动作表征对齐与 MeanFlow 规划器实现端到端自动驾驶。
result.reason: Contributes world/action representation learning (predictive latent world representation, SIGReg stabilization, visual-action alignment) for a driving world action model, though main application is autonomous driving planning.
